query:
SELECT 'Companies' as entity, COUNT(*) as count FROM companies
UNION ALL SELECT 'Divisions', COUNT(*) FROM divisions
UNION ALL SELECT 'Departments', COUNT(*) FROM departments
UNION ALL SELECT 'Company Teams', COUNT(*) FROM companyTeams
UNION ALL SELECT 'Staff', COUNT(*) FROM staff
UNION ALL SELECT 'Clients', COUNT(*) FROM clients
UNION ALL SELECT 'Cases', COUNT(*) FROM cases
UNION ALL SELECT 'Sessions', COUNT(*) FROM sessions;

SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as divisions_count
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN divisions d ON d.companyId = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
